texto.es: Nos cuentas qué le pasa a tu auto y te damos la primera orientación por teléfono.
texto.en: Tell us what is going on with your car and we will point you in the right direction over the phone.

texto.es: Traes tu vehiculo al taller para que lo revisemos y hagamos un diagnóstico real, no por teléfono.
texto.en: You bring your vehicle to the shop so we can take a real look and diagnose it in person, not over the phone.

texto.es: Te damos un precio claro despues de revisar el auto, sin cargos escondidos ni sorpresas.
texto.en: We give you a clear price after looking at the car, no hidden charges, no surprises.

texto.es: Reparamos tu auto con el mismo cuidado que ves en nuestro taller y te lo entregamos listo para rodar.
texto.en: We repair your car with the same care you see in our shop and hand it back ready to drive.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza despues de revisar tu vehiculo en el taller. Llamanos y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every job is quoted after we look at your vehicle in the shop. Call us and we will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: Cambio de aceite y filtro rápido, para que tu auto siga rodando sin contratiempos.
texto.en: Fast oil and filter changes, so your car keeps running without trouble.

texto.es: Venta e instalación de llantas con precios competitivos, más rotación y balanceo.
texto.en: Tire sales and installation at competitive prices, plus rotation and balancing.

texto.es: Revisión y reparación de frenos, pastillas y discos para que frenes con confianza.
texto.en: Brake inspection and repair, pads and rotors, so you can stop with confidence.

texto.es: Diagnóstico y reparación general para autos, camionetas y SUVs de todas las marcas.
texto.en: General diagnostics and repair for cars, trucks and SUVs of every make.

pie.es: ¿No ves exactamente lo que necesitas? Llamanos igual: la mayoría de nuestros trabajos empiezan como una consulta puntual.

items.quote: Friendly and competent. They were able to squeeze me in for an oil change and tire rotation on short notice. It only took 30 minutes and they were on time. All the work was performed flawlessly. The prices were very reasonable. They take good care of their customers.

I recently had the pleasure of working with Mike at University Auto Repair, and I cannot recommend him highly enough. After shopping around extensively for new tires I found that Mike offered the most competitive prices in town. His affordability is unmatched, and the quality of services is outstanding.

If you're looking for exceptional Auto Repair Service look no further than University Auto Repair. The owner Mike offeres personalized service that truly stands out not only is the service Top Notch but the tire prices are also affordable. Highly recommended for anyone in need of reliable and cost-effective Auto Care
